title: PeerHouseholdEdge
description: Per-household reciprocation edge in a peer topology view. Source of truth: peer_identity_bindings (Category A from imagodei DHT) joined with rea_commitments + economic_events for hosting accounting (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

householdId.description: Stable identifier for the counterparty household.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the household, when known.

online.description: Whether at least one peer in the household is currently online.

lastSyncSec.description: Seconds since the last successful sync with the counterparty.

myCidsHostedByThem.description: Count of viewer's CIDs currently replicated by the counterparty household.

theirCidsHostedByMe.description: Count of counterparty CIDs currently replicated by the viewer's household.

isCriticalForMe.description: True when this household holds CIDs for which the viewer would lose sole-replica protection if it goes dark.

iAmCriticalForThem.description: True when the viewer is the only off-household replica of CIDs the counterparty owns.
